children: TRON DAO will ring the closing bell at Cboe Global Markets’ Chicago trading floor today, September 29, to mark the listing of TRXS, an exchange-traded product offering staked exposure to TRX. According to BeInCrypto, the fund, listed on Cboe on September 9, seeks spot TRX exposure and additional TRX through delegated proof-of-stake rewards, with Justin Sun praising Canary Capital’s launch. TRON said the network supports more than $94 billion in circulating USDT and about $6.1 trillion in USDT transfer volume year-to-date.

title: TRON DAO To Ring Cboe Closing Bell For Canary Staked TRX ETF Debut
